2126058665245376631.en_summary: Consumers now spend 50% more on streaming than they did on cable in 1995, and many still pay for cable too. This is not helping $NFLX, which is in a 56% drawdown.

2126050862296596904.en_summary: In 2023, Metro Bank $MTRO.LN needed a rescue. Colombian billionaire Jaime Gilinski led a £925 million refinancing and ended up with 53%. This month Metro put itself up for sale after its best half-year profit on record. The shares trade at more than six times the rescue price. Kliff Notes said this one will most likely be sold.
2126050862296596904.zh_summary: 2023 年，Metro Bank $MTRO.LN 需要救助。哥倫比亞億萬富翁 Jaime Gilinski 領導了 9.25 億英鎊的再融資，最終持有 53%。本月 Metro 在創下最好半年度利潤後將自己掛牌出售。股價交易價格是救助價格的六倍以上。Kliff Notes 表示這隻股票很可能會被出售。
